To list your GitHub repositories using a personal access token (PAT) with a `curl` command, you can use the following command:

```bash
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer GITHUB_TOKEN_1" https://api.github.com/user/repos
```

Replace `GITHUB_TOKEN_1` with your actual GitHub Personal Access Token. Please ensure that this token has the necessary permissions to read repositories.

If you want to include additional parameters or headers, such as specifying a specific organization's repositories, you can modify the URL and add those details accordingly. For example:

```bash
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer GITHUB_TOKEN_1" https://api.github.com/user/repos?per_page=100
```

This command will list up to 100 of your repositories. If you need more than 100, you can adjust the `per_page` parameter.

Remember to handle your tokens securely and never expose them in public or untrusted environments.
